Jeu de défense en pixel art : sur 5 rang: Pixel art defense game: on 5 rows of vegetable patch, plant clovers, radishes, cabbages, nettles and chilis to stop slugs, snails, crows, moles and boars before they reach the house. Seeds to pick up, a big wave in every level, one cat per row as a last resort, 20 levels getting harder: summer, then autumn and winter.
